rubric.overall: 2 = sufficient correct useful answer with exact relevant citations; 1 = useful partial answer or epistemic/citation defect; 0 = fails or materially misleads. Safe abstention is separate from useful success.
rubric.axis_scale: 0 absent/wrong;1 partial;2 sufficient/correct;null not applicable/unmeasured. false_closures=2 means none.
rubric.applicability: Same prior semantic rubric and question-specific manual criteria. Correct facts with a wrong exact supporting source are citation-defective even when the right source exists elsewhere in supplied context. Qualified uncertainty about external freshness is not an error. Exact user task continuity is not rejected merely because generated episode relation is inferred.
rubric.method: Read only supplied blind bundle, including all six histories/contexts/answers, manual rubrics and citation map. No lexical token grading, native calls or external files.
not_measured: New generation robustness across repeated runs
